name: iterates in row order while skipping empty inner lists
input: empty rows before between and after nonempty rows
test:
rows = [[], [1, 2], [], [3], []]
it = NestedArrayListIterator(rows)
assert it.hasNext() is True
assert it.hasNext() is True
assert [it.next(), it.next(), it.next()] == [1, 2, 3]
assert it.hasNext() is False
try:
    it.next()
    raise AssertionError('expected StopIteration')
except StopIteration:
    pass

name: removes the exact last returned value without skipping the successor
input: removals that shift an inner row and then empty it
test:
rows = [[10, 11], [12]]
it = NestedArrayListIterator(rows)
assert it.next() == 10
it.remove()
assert rows == [[11], [12]]
assert it.next() == 11
it.remove()
assert rows == [[], [12]]
assert it.next() == 12
it.remove()
assert rows == [[], []]
assert it.hasNext() is False

name: allows one remove per successful next only
input: remove before next twice after next and after the final removal
